ModMetaData.name: History Graph Performance Fix
ModMetaData.author: ifchen0
ModMetaData.description:
Removes the lag of the History tab graph in long-running colonies.
Vanilla rebuilds every graph curve from the full history on every tick while the game runs, and draws one line segment per record (tens of thousands of segments per frame after a few hundred in-game years). Every event mark (raids, marriages...) is drawn separately even when hundreds land on the same pixel.
Fix: - Curves are rebuilt only when a new record is added or the shown range changes. - Within the shown range, records are reduced to the lowest and highest value of each small time slice, so peaks and dips stay visible and the scale is unchanged. Short ranges still show every record. - Event marks that land on the same pixel with the same color are drawn once; their tooltips still work.
Safe to add to or remove from an existing save. History data is not changed.
